candidates.title: FairCache: Demystifying Cache-Induced Unfairness in Multi-Tenant Large Language Model Serving
candidates.reason: context cachingによるcompute/memory/I-O fairnessを統合しshared-prefix cost再配分とmax-min cache allocationを行うmulti-tenant serving研究。

candidates.title: CALSI: Context-Aware Layer Skipping Inference for On-Device LLM Serving
candidates.reason: token別layer skippingとKV cache delayed computationを組み合わせ実deviceで最大24.1% latency削減するon-device推論研究。

candidates.title: AsymFlow: Enabling Long-Context LLM Serving via CPU-GPU Prefill-Decode Disaggregation
candidates.reason: GPU prefill/CPU decode分離、shared-memory KV streaming、AMX attentionでGPU-only OOM長文脈を処理しthroughput最大2.49x改善。

candidates.title: CrossServe: Cross-Layer Scheduling for SLO Optimization in Multi-Tenant LLM Serving
candidates.reason: routing・adaptive micro-batching・weighted preemptionをcross-layer統合し32-GPU traceでSLO attainmentを95%へ改善。

candidates.title: ReliefServe: Relieving GPU Pressure in Multi-Model Serving via Selective CPU Escape
candidates.reason: burst時にCPU-tolerant modelだけをCPUへescapeしGPU interferenceを緩和、12-server実験でgoodput最大39.74%改善。

discovery_stats.query_summary: vLLM前方引用100件からschema v3で未収録20件を抽出し、multi-tenant cache、on-device、CPU-GPU分離、SLO scheduling、CPU offloadの5件を採用。
